description: This file defines the Operations class with static methods for matrix operations such as add, direct sum, divide, multiply, and subtract, utilizing external operator classes.

classes.name: Operations
classes.description: Provides static methods for performing various matrix operations by delegating to operator classes.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Performs addition on multiple matrices or arrays, returning a Matrix.

methods.name: directsum
methods.description: Performs direct sum on multiple matrices or arrays, returning a Matrix.

methods.name: divideby
methods.description: Performs division of matrices in sequence, returning a Matrix.

methods.name: divideinto
methods.description: Performs division of matrices in reverse order, returning a Matrix.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Performs multiplication on multiple matrices or arrays, returning a Matrix.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Performs subtraction on multiple matrices or arrays, returning a Matrix.
